test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

One should work __hard than__ others to succeed.
solution:
The correct answer is **'harder than'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There is an error in the **adjective usage** in the underlined part of the given sentence. 
 
• There is a comparison happening in the sentence between the work done by an individual and the work done by others. 
 
• To make it correct we need to substitute it with the correct comparative adjective form of **hard.**
 
• *Adjectives with two syllables can form the **comparative either by adding -er **or by **preceding the adjective with more.**__*
 
• So, **harder **is the correct **comparative degree** of the adjective for the given sentence. 
 
• So, either **option 1 or ****option 3 **is the correct substitute. 
 
• But the given sentence has two clauses - The **independent clause **'*One should work hard'* and the **dependent clause** '*other to succeed'.*
 
• We need to join the two parts with a conjunction. 
 
• **Than **is a conjunction while **to **is a preposition. 
 
• Hence, **option 1 or harder than **is the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

**__Correct sentence__** - *One should work **__harder than__**** **others to succeed.*
